name: Multiblock
description: A machine built from several blocks working as one.

pages.title: Multiblock
pages.text:
A **multiblock** is a machine made of several blocks that work as one. Fluid Tanks and Item Vaults join up, and a steam boiler is a multiblock.\
\
Others in the pack: TFMG's blast furnace, the Create Nuclear reactor, Ratatouille's Oven and the Modular Accumulator. Shape matters, so check Ponder.
